applies_to: APC Symmetra PX 250/500 kW three-phase UPS via Network Management Card AP9635, register map 990-3936D (firmware sypx510 to sypx516 changes listed in the source).
summary: The Symmetra PX 250/500 kW publishes a large Modbus map through its AP9635 network card, over RTU or TCP. Status and alarm registers at 40001 onward are bit fields; measurements (battery, input, bypass, output per phase, load, energy, temperatures, operating modes and component lifetimes) are 16- or 32-bit holding registers from 44097 onward, with documented multiply/divide scaling.

addressing.note: Each row shows the Modicon number, the absolute address in hex and decimal; note 12 says absolute address 0 is register 40001 and address zero on the wire.

source.title: Modbus Register Map: Symmetra PX 250/500 kW

notes: Source host: this is the APC document as republished by integrator Control Concepts (ccontrols.com); APC's own download links refuse automated requests.
Word order: note 2 says INT32/UINT32 have the most significant word in n+0, so 32-bit values are ABCD. Note 3: function codes 3 and 4 are both supported.
Strings are two characters per register, high byte first, without a null terminator.

Left out: rows whose multiply and divide columns disagree (the parallel-system %-load registers show multiply 1 but divide 10), rows with no data type, and per-module lifetime registers for frames 1-3 (frame 0 kept as the pattern).
Accessing an undefined range returns an illegal-data-address error. Detailed comms settings are in the AP9635 user's guide.

integration.summary: Read the status/alarm block from 0 and the measurement blocks from 0x1100 (battery), 0x1200 (input), 0x1300 (bypass), 0x1400 (output) and 0x1500 (system) with function 03 or 04.

minimum_registers.why: UPS status bits (on battery, bypass, alarms)

integration.enable: Enable Modbus (serial RTU or TCP) on the AP9635 Network Management Card; see its user's guide.
quirks: Status bits are only consistent within one register; do not combine bits across registers.
Frequencies, PF, crest factor and % load use a 0.1 scale.
setup: Serial/TCP parameters and unit ID are configured on the AP9635 card.
gotchas: Some registers were added in later firmware (sypx512, sypx515, sypx516) and may be missing on older firmware.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
